t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Certain baskets have a better chance of giving higher mushrooms and when it slows down, switch to the other colour gnomes

vb_textbox.text: Take note of how many mushrooms the colour of the basket is giving you, if it is yellow and is giving you decent amounts, pick the yellow/green/blue gnome. If it starts slowing down and gives you less, pick the red/pink/brown gnome.
